title: Better Auto Clicker
description: A highly advanced and polished Minecraft Fabric utility mod featuring customizable combat profiles, weapon cooldown, auto-bridging, auto-eating, and auto-healing.
body:
![Better Auto Clicker Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/126a030a2b311652fab1895311585781f3292545.png) > - **_REQUIRES FABRIC API_** A highly polished, feature-rich utility and automation mod for Fabric. Automate combat, bridging, eating, and healing with a clean, modern three-column GUI and instant profile switching. --- ## ⚙️ Features * **⚡ Advanced Clicking:** Fully configurable click automation for both Left (Attack) and Right (Use) buttons. * **⚔️ Cooldown-Synced Combat:** Synchronizes attacks with weapon cooldown progress and halts if your shield is raised. * **🎯 Entity Target Filters:** Choose target categories to control who you attack: * **All Mobs** — Attack any target in sight. * **Hostiles Only** — Attack monsters only. * **Passives Only** — Target animals/passive mobs. * *Note: Villagers, Golems, Pets, and players are automatically protected in filtered modes.*
🎬 Click to expand combat filter previews ### All Mobs Mode ![All Mobs Mode](https://i.ibb.co/xqzC3MJS/All-Mob-Mode-ezgif.com-optimize.gif) ### Hostiles Only Mode ![Hostiles Only Mode](https://i.ibb.co/ymfCbcyy/Hostile-Only-Mode-ezgif.com-optimize.gif) ### Passives Only Mode ![Passives Only Mode](https://i.ibb.co/Pvj8fQHY/Passive-Only-Mode-ezgif.com-optimize.gif) ### Hostiles & Passives Mode ![Hostiles & Passives Mode](https://i.ibb.co/YF5zFMVd/Hostile-Passive-Only-Mode-ezgif.com-optimize.gif)
* **🌉 Auto-Bridging:** Safely places blocks while walking backwards/sideways on edges. Automatically swaps hotbar slots to matching block types, and **locks you in sneak** if you run out of blocks so you never fall. ![Auto-Bridging Preview](https://i.ibb.co/TBSSBmFX/auto-Bridge-ezgif.com-optimize.gif) * **🍎 Auto-Eat & Auto-Heal:** * **Auto-Eat** — Swaps to food when hunger drops 4 bars down ($\le 12$) and eats until full. * **Auto-Heal** — Swaps to Golden Apples or Healing/Regen Potions when health drops to $\le 10$ (5 hearts). ### Auto-Eat Demo ![Auto-Eat Preview](https://i.ibb.co/6cjhSDvN/auto-Eat-ezgif.com-optimize.gif) ### Auto-Heal Demo ![Auto-Heal Preview](https://i.imgur.com/5a0ihkE.gif) * **🗃️ Preset Profiles:** Switch presets instantly (includes *Default*, *PVP Mode*, *AFK Mob Farm*, and *Block Bridging*). * **📖 In-Game Guide Panel:** Built-in left-side guide detailing mod features and settings instructions. --- ## 🚀 How to Use 1. Press **`O`** to open the custom three-column settings GUI. 2. Press **`I`** to globally toggle all active automation features ON/OFF. > ⚠️ **IMPORTANT** > Make sure to toggle the autoclicker on (default key: **`I`**) for automated features (like Auto-Bridge, Auto-Eat, and Auto-Heal) to function. --- ## 🛠️ Configuration Preset Details
Click to expand profile descriptions * **Default:** Standard config. * **PVP Mode:** Cooldown sync & shield mode active. * **AFK Mob Farm:** Auto cooldown attacks, AFK mob mode active targeting Hostiles only. * **Block Bridging:** Fast right-click spamming with Auto-Bridge enabled.
